headline: SpaceX Valuation Declines Amid Broader Tech and AI Market Correction
summary: Shares in SpaceX have fallen as part of a wider downturn in technology and artificial intelligence stocks. The market reaction follows concerns regarding potential regulatory scrutiny over data center infrastructure and the AI industry.
why: SpaceX is a major private aerospace manufacturer and satellite communications company. Market sentiment toward high-growth tech and AI-exposed assets often shifts based on regulatory outlooks and macroeconomic conditions.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: The company's valuation is reported to have declined alongside the broader tech sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The decline in SpaceX shares is attributed to a broader market sell-off in technology and AI stocks, driven by investor uncertainty regarding future regulatory oversight of data centers and AI development.
